lines.reason: Real ~90 deg tab fold (patches 1/3 outer skin, both plane rms<0.01 mm). Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the label point on the outer-arc apex (|offset| <=0.06 mm; the inner skin sits 1.9 mm in along the bisector = thickness). Outer apex points run t=-0.2..13.7 mm (~13.9 mm fold width); the 13.35 mm line covers about 96%, from the free edge of the tab to the slot. Parallel to the fold.
